# Operations Strategy Monitoring and Optimization

This document details critical operational tasks for the 2026 strategy and ongoing performance management.

## Key Operational Directives:

*   Investigate branch efficiency on a quarterly basis.
*   Monitor cash flow to support the 2026 strategy.
*   Review branch efficiency as part of the 2026 strategy.
*   Optimize customer wait times for the 2026 strategy.
*   Investigate customer wait times based on audit findings.
